spec.description:
The STINGER CH38-2 is an award-winning, non-pneumatic cap hammer
tacker engineered to deliver the superior holding power of a plastic cap
combined with the speed and simplicity of a manual hammer tacker. Specifically
designed for securing housewrap, synthetic roofing underlayment, and rolled
insulation, it automatically feeds and drives a full 25mm plastic cap with
a 10mm crown staple with every swing. By eliminating compressors and hoses, it
provides an economical, portable solution that seals fastener penetrations and
prevents tearing in windy conditions.
features:
Non-pneumatic hammer
tacker delivering both a plastic cap and staple in a single strike
High-capacity magazine holds 168 plastic collated caps and 168 staples

Drives full 25mm (1 inch) diameter plastic caps with 10mm (3/8 inch) crown
staples

Eliminates the cost, weight, and setup of air compressors, hoses, and
power cords

Caps create a seal over staple penetrations to prevent water and
moisture ingress

Significantly reduces blow-offs, tearing, and lateral
slippage of building wraps and felts

Lightweight 1.17 kg ergonomic design
reduces arm fatigue during all-day use

Easy trigger-advance cap mechanism
prepares each cap instantly for driving

technical.value: 25 mm (1 inch) full plastic collated caps

10 mm (3/8
inch) crown staples / A-11 style

Manual strike with
trigger cap feed (CH38-2) or automatic feed (CH38A)

spec.sustainability:
Eliminates fuel and electrical power
consumption of compressors; recyclable steel body and plastic caps
install:
Open the staple magazine at the base and insert a strip of STINGER 10mm
staples

Open the cap gate, place a reel of 168 collated plastic caps into the
basket, and feed the lead cap into the guide

Close and latch both magazines
securely before operation

Hold the hammer handle firmly and pull the trigger
to advance a cap into the strike zone

Strike the target building wrap or roof
underlayment firmly against the timber substrate with a standard hammer motion

Ensure the staple drives fully through the center of the plastic cap flush
against the membrane

Repeat across the wall or roof at the spacing
recommended by the membrane manufacturer (typically 300mm to 600mm centers)
selection_checklist:
Confirm application is fixing pliable building wrap or
roof underlayment to timber framing or plywood decking

Verify need for
airless manual installation without compressor hoses on roofs or scaffolding
Ensure genuine STINGER 10mm StaplePac refills (#136420) are ordered

Choose
between CH38-2 (manual trigger advance) and CH38A (automatic swing advance)
accessories:
STINGER StaplePac 10mm (SKU: 136420, 2016 count box covers
~250 m²)
limitations:
Designed for
timber framing and wood substrates only; cannot penetrate steel framing or
masonry

Must be loaded exclusively with genuine STINGER 10mm StaplePac
fasteners

Not recommended where local high-wind codes mandate ring-shank
nails (use CN100B)

problem_keywords:
dragging air hoses across
pitched roof

slow hand nailing of cap
fasteners
use_cases:
Fast manual installation of synthetic roof underlayment and
roofing felt to timber roof trusses and plywood decking

Securing residential
vapour-permeable wall wraps and reflective foil sarking to timber wall framing

Holding rolled blanket insulation in place before cladding without dragging air
hoses on scaffolding
not_for:
Steel-framed structures (cannot drive
staples into steel studs)
retrieval.rag_summary:
The STINGER CH (CH38-2 / CH38A) is a manual,
non-pneumatic cap hammer tacker engineered by National Nail to install
housewrap, roofing underlayment, and rolled insulation. With every swing, it
automatically positions a 25mm (1 inch) plastic collated cap and drives a 10mm
(3/8 inch) crown staple through its center into timber framing. Weighing 1.17 kg
and holding 168 caps and staples (loaded with STINGER StaplePac), it eliminates
compressor hoses on roofs while sealing staple penetrations against water leaks
and preventing high-wind blow-offs.
